lyrics.ja: あの一等星のさんざめく光で
lyrics.romaji: Ano Ittousei no Sanzameku Hikari de

lyrics.zh: 以那顆一等星璀璨喧鬧的光芒

lyrics.ja: あなたとダンスを踊ろうか
lyrics.romaji: Anata to Dansu wo Odorou ka

lyrics.ja: 我が太陽系の鼓動に合わせて
lyrics.romaji: Waga Taiyoukei no Kodou ni Awasete
lyrics.en: Matching the heartbeat of our solar system
lyrics.zh: 配合我們太陽系的脈動

lyrics.ja: 絡まったステップで綺羅めいて 星ッ!
lyrics.romaji: Karamatta Suteppu de Kirameite Hoshi!
lyrics.en: With tangled steps, sparkling—star!
lyrics.zh: 以交纏的舞步閃耀，星！

lyrics.ja: ランバダ ルンバ ふたり 宇宙でランデブーな
lyrics.romaji: Ranbada Runba Futari Uchuu de Randebuu na
lyrics.en: Lambada, rumba—the two of us rendezvous in space
lyrics.zh: 蘭巴達、倫巴，兩人在宇宙中相會

lyrics.ja: 妄 患って 連夜眠れない
lyrics.romaji: Mou Wazuratte Renya Nemurenai
lyrics.en: Sick with delusion, I can't sleep night after night
lyrics.zh: 患上妄想，連夜無法入眠

lyrics.ja: 星座になって 混ざる どんな一等星も
lyrics.romaji: Seiza ni Natte Mazaru Donna Ittousei mo
lyrics.en: Even any first-magnitude star that becomes a constellation and blends in
lyrics.zh: 化為星座交融，無論哪顆一等星

lyrics.ja: あなたに 代わる 光度はないわ
lyrics.romaji: Anata ni Kawaru Koudou ha Nai wa
lyrics.en: There's no luminosity that can replace you
lyrics.zh: 沒有能取代你的光度

lyrics.ja: 校舎の裏 あの日 あなた見つけた
lyrics.romaji: Kousha no Ura Ano Hi Anata Mitsuketa
lyrics.en: Behind the school building that day, I found you
lyrics.zh: 校舍後方，那一天我找到了你

lyrics.ja: 奇跡さえ 今も はなれない
lyrics.romaji: Kiseki Sae Ima mo Hanarenai
lyrics.en: Even the miracle won't leave me even now
lyrics.zh: 連奇蹟至今也離不開

lyrics.ja: 隣に 繁く 見える 冥王星も
lyrics.romaji: Tonari ni Shigeku Mieru Meiousei mo
lyrics.en: Even Pluto, which I often see nearby
lyrics.zh: 連身旁頻頻可見的冥王星

lyrics.ja: 生憎 今は 興味がないわ
lyrics.romaji: Ainiku Ima ha Kyoumi ga Nai wa
lyrics.en: Unfortunately, I have no interest now
lyrics.zh: 不巧的是，如今毫無興趣

lyrics.ja: 星が舞っちゃって
lyrics.romaji: Hoshi ga Matchatte
lyrics.en: The stars dance about
lyrics.zh: 星星飛舞起來

lyrics.ja: 胸が鳴っちゃって
lyrics.romaji: Mune ga Natchatte
lyrics.en: My heart pounds
lyrics.zh: 胸口作響

lyrics.ja: 気付けば彼方
lyrics.romaji: Kizukeba Kanata
lyrics.en: Before I know it, I'm far away
lyrics.zh: 回過神已身在遠方

lyrics.ja: あの一等星のさんざめく光で
lyrics.romaji: Ano Ittousei no Sanzameku Hikari de
lyrics.en: In the dazzling light of that first-magnitude star
lyrics.zh: 以那顆一等星璀璨喧鬧的光芒

lyrics.ja: あなたとダンスを踊ろうか
lyrics.romaji: Anata to Dansu wo Odorou ka
lyrics.en: Shall we dance together?
lyrics.zh: 與你共舞一曲如何

lyrics.ja: 我が太陽系の法則に誘われ
lyrics.romaji: Waga Taiyoukei no Housoku ni Sasoware
lyrics.en: Invited by the laws of our solar system
lyrics.zh: 受我們太陽系法則的邀請

lyrics.ja: 交わった感度で綺羅めいて 星ッ!
lyrics.romaji: Majiwartta Kando de Kirameite Hoshi!
lyrics.en: With crossed sensitivity, sparkling—star!
lyrics.zh: 以交會的感度閃耀，星！

lyrics.ja: オー オ オー! 星間線を絆いで
lyrics.romaji: Oo O Oo! Seikan Sen wo Tsunaide
lyrics.en: Oh, oh, oh! Binding interstellar lines
lyrics.zh: 喔 喔 喔！連繫星際線

lyrics.ja: オー オ オー! あなたに届け
lyrics.romaji: Oo O Oo! Anata ni Todoke
lyrics.en: Oh, oh, oh! Reaching you
lyrics.zh: 喔 喔 喔！傳達給你

lyrics.ja: オー オ オー! 宇宙の果てから
lyrics.romaji: Oo O Oo! Uchuu no Hate kara
lyrics.en: Oh, oh, oh! From the ends of the universe
lyrics.zh: 喔 喔 喔！從宇宙盡頭

lyrics.ja: オー オ オー! あなた 侵光系!
lyrics.romaji: Oo O Oo! Anata Shinkoukei!
lyrics.en: Oh, oh, oh! You're an invading light system!
lyrics.zh: 喔 喔 喔！你是侵光系！

lyrics.ja: 大体のダンスは 星が光り標となるのさ
lyrics.romaji: Daitai no Dansu ha Hoshi ga Hikari Shirube to Naru no sa
lyrics.en: In most dances, the stars become a guiding light
lyrics.zh: 大抵的舞蹈，星星會成為光芒指引

lyrics.ja: 未体験なステッポで ha, ha, ha, ha
lyrics.romaji: Mitaiken na Suteppo de Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha
lyrics.en: With unexperienced steps—ha, ha, ha, ha
lyrics.zh: 用從未體驗過的舞步，ha, ha, ha, ha

lyrics.ja: 大胆なスタンスで 周回軌道上なぞるのさ
lyrics.romaji: Daitan na Sutansu de Shuukai Kidou jou Nazoru no sa
lyrics.en: With a bold stance, tracing along the orbit
lyrics.zh: 以大膽的姿態，沿著軌道描繪

lyrics.ja: 太陽系のデスコで ha, ha, ha, ha
lyrics.romaji: Taiyoukei no Desuko de Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha
lyrics.en: At the solar system disco—ha, ha, ha, ha
lyrics.zh: 在太陽系的迪斯可，ha, ha, ha, ha

lyrics.ja: 宙 揺蕩って いつか ふたり忘れる
lyrics.romaji: Chuu Tayutatte Itsuka Futari Wasureru
lyrics.en: Drifting in space, someday the two of us will forget
lyrics.zh: 在宇宙中漂蕩，總有一天兩人會遺忘

lyrics.ja: 言葉さえ 今は求めたい
lyrics.romaji: Kotoba Sae Ima ha Motometai
lyrics.en: Even words—I want to seek them now
lyrics.zh: 如今甚至渴望著言語

lyrics.ja: 超新星を願う 暮れた世界も
lyrics.romaji: Choushinsei wo Negau Kureta Sekai mo
lyrics.en: Even a darkened world that wishes for a supernova
lyrics.zh: 連祈願超新星的落幕世界

lyrics.ja: 不思議と 今はどうでもいいわ
lyrics.romaji: Fushigi to Ima ha Dou demo Ii wa
lyrics.en: Strangely, I don't care now
lyrics.zh: 不可思議地，如今都無所謂了

lyrics.ja: 何もなくたって
lyrics.romaji: Nani mo Nakutatte
lyrics.en: Even if there's nothing
lyrics.zh: 即使什麼都沒有

lyrics.ja: 何となくだって
lyrics.romaji: Nantonaku Datte
lyrics.en: Even just somehow
lyrics.zh: 即使只是隱約

lyrics.ja: 星は巡って
lyrics.romaji: Hoshi ha Megutte
lyrics.en: The stars keep orbiting
lyrics.zh: 星辰依然循環

lyrics.ja: あの一等星の届かぬ光は
lyrics.romaji: Ano Ittousei no Todokanu Hikari ha
lyrics.en: The unreachable light of that first-magnitude star
lyrics.zh: 那顆一等星無法觸及的光芒

lyrics.ja: 遥かな彼方で綺羅めいた
lyrics.romaji: Haruka na Kanata de Kirameita
lyrics.en: Sparkled in the far distance
lyrics.zh: 在遙遠的彼方閃耀

lyrics.ja: 我が太陽系の法則も外れて
lyrics.romaji: Waga Taiyoukei no Housoku mo Hazurete
lyrics.en: Even straying from the laws of our solar system
lyrics.zh: 即使偏離我們太陽系的法則

lyrics.ja: 「それでもいいさ」手をのばして!
lyrics.romaji: 「Sore demo Ii sa」 Te wo Nobashite!
lyrics.en: "Even so, it's fine" — reach out your hand!
lyrics.zh: 「那也無妨」伸出手吧！

lyrics.ja: さあ 幾星霜と宿した想いで
lyrics.romaji: Saa Ikuseisou to Yadoshita Omoi de
lyrics.en: Now, with feelings harbored through countless years
lyrics.zh: 來吧，懷著歷經無數星霜的思念

lyrics.ja: あなたの全て求めようか
lyrics.romaji: Anata no Subete Motomeyou ka
lyrics.en: Shall I seek all of you?
lyrics.zh: 追求你的一切如何

lyrics.ja: ねえ 何光年の広大な旅路で
lyrics.romaji: Nee Nan Kounen no Koudai na Tabiji de
lyrics.en: Hey, on this vast journey of how many light years
lyrics.zh: 吶，在多少光年的浩瀚旅途中

lyrics.ja: 比翼の恋理を探そうか
lyrics.romaji: Hiyoku no Renri wo Sagasou ka
lyrics.en: Shall we search for the logic of love as wing-to-wing birds?
lyrics.zh: 尋找比翼連理的戀愛定理如何

lyrics.en: Look—Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune too
lyrics.zh: 看啊，水金也好，地火木土天海也罷

lyrics.ja: ふたりの銀河で綺羅めいた 星ッ!
lyrics.romaji: Futari no Ginga de Kirameita Hoshi!
lyrics.en: All sparkled in our galaxy—star!
lyrics.zh: 都在兩人的銀河裡閃耀，星！
